comment: 42yo female with NF1 confirmed on germline testing in childhood (≥6 café-au-lait macules + axillary freckling + 2 cutaneous neurofibromas + maternal NF1 — meets NIH/Bethesda criteria). No personal cancer to date. NF1 carriers have multi-organ predisposition: women have lifetime breast cancer ~18% by age 50, ~50% by age 70 (comparable to BRCA2 but with earlier onset); MPNST ~10-15% lifetime (malignant transformation of plexiform neurofibromas); CNS gliomas across the lifespan. Fires RF-NF1-CONFIRMED-CARRIER (relevant_diseases: low-grade glioma, breast, soft-tissue sarcoma). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: default = IND-NF1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-SURVEILLANCE (annual breast MRI from age 30 + mammography from age 30; whole-body MRI for MPNST surveillance + symptom-driven biopsy of growing/painful plexiform NFs; neurology follow-up); alternative = IND-NF1-CARRIER-PREVENTION-OBSERVATION (cascade testing + symptom-driven workup).
